details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2221-2227 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The new `review_head_gate_updater_exempt` call in the judge's `updater_verify_hold` branch never sees `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_UPDATER_EXEMPT_ENABLED`, because scripts/review_head_gate.sh defaults it with `: "${REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_UPDATER_EXEMPT_ENABLED:=true}"`, so inside the judge the switch is always `true`.
  WHY: With the repository variable set to `false`, which README.md, changelog.d and agents.d document as restoring the old behaviour, the judge still posts `ai-review/head-gate=success` on review-blocked updater PRs. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4531-4580 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The env block of the "Review-blocked judge decision" step (id: rb_judge, from line 4531; luna cites 4535-4561; the script runs at line 4580) does not pass `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_UPDATER_EXEMPT_ENABLED`, while the head_gate step (line 750) and the "Enable auto-merge on PR" step (line 4436) do, and there is no workflow-level or job-level copy.
  WHY: The kill switch covers only two of the three paths that write the status, so the documented opt-out fails on the judge path. Fix: add `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_UPDATER_EXEMPT_ENABLED: ${{ vars.REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_UPDATER_EXEMPT_ENABLED || 'true' }}` and extend `test_review_autofix_passes_head_ref_and_switch_to_the_gate`. This is the same root cause as the review_rb_judge.sh entry, but it is listed separately because the file differs. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:244-250 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `pin_threshold_label()` checks the value with `raw.isdigit()`, which rejects a leading `+`, while `parse_pin_max_age_seconds` (scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:1352-1364) uses `int(str(value).strip())`, which accepts it.
  WHY: With `CONSUMER_PIN_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=+3600`, the audit alarms after 1 hour but the report heading falls back to "24 hours", silently showing operators the wrong threshold even though the docstring claims to mirror the parser. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- tests/test_update_workflows_template_gate.py:574-582 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `FAKE_CURL` hardcodes `exit 0`, so no test exercises the `curl -sS --fail ... || echo "::warning::Telegram send failed"` failure branch in `verify_merge_blocked` (update_workflows.yml:2531-2534). Minimax also cites the _run_merge_blocked tests at 610-638.
  WHY: A later edit that drops `--fail` or breaks the `||` chain would not be caught by CI, and Telegram errors would again be swallowed. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:2527 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new Telegram `curl` uses `--fail`, but its exit status is not checked effectively, because it is chained with `echo "::warning::..."`, which always exits 0.
  WHY: `set -uo pipefail` will not catch the curl failure in this context, which may mask Telegram delivery failures or make them hard to debug, despite the warning (rated NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #9483 fix 3: "Exempt update PRs that pass both `ai-update-workflows/verify` and `workflow-integrity` from `ai-review/head-gate`, or have the gate post success for them." The head gate "stayed `pending` the whole time".
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml verify job (`verify_publish` after verify succeeds / `verify_merge_blocked`), or a status-triggered re-run of review_autofix's head_gate step that calls review_head_gate_updater_exempt
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The exemption is invoked only from `review_head_gate_main`, the `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` updater exit, and the `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2222` `updater_verify_hold` branch, all of which run during review_autofix and can run before verify succeeds. The `verify_publish` step at `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:2431-2447` and the new `verify_merge_blocked` step post only the verify status and never post or re-request the head gate. `workflow-templates/ai-review.yml:18-23` triggers review on pull-request events, schedule and manual dispatch, not on status events. When verify lands after review has finished, every check returns `verify_missing`/`verify_not_success` and the gate stays `pending`. update_workflows.yml is in the plan's files_touched grant, and the previous editor's "TASK_GAP_DEFERRED … outside the approved scope" is not backed by a deferral in the issue or plan. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT ("window is narrow"); gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2222-2224 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `review_head_gate_updater_exempt "${REPOSITORY}" "${PR_NUMBER}" "${RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA:-}" "${POST_REVIEW_HEAD_REF}" || true` was added as a third caller in the judge's `updater_verify_hold` branch. The "Review-blocked judge decision" step (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml line 4525, env from 4531, runs at 4580) does not pass `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_UPDATER_EXEMPT_ENABLED`, which is set only at lines 750 and 4436, so the `:=true` default in scripts/review_head_gate.sh always applies.
  WHY: With the variable set to `false`, the judge still posts `ai-review/head-gate` = `success` on review-blocked updater PRs, so the kill switch covers only 2 of 3 paths. Fix: add the env line to the judge step and extend `test_review_autofix_passes_head_ref_and_switch_to_the_gate`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:"Review-blocked judge decision" step env (from line 4531) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: This is the same root cause, seen as a trust-boundary issue: the declared kill switch and the effective one do not match, because the judge path keeps posting success.
  WHY: An operator who sets `false` still gets success statuses from the judge path. Fix: the same one-line env addition.
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:"Build report artifacts" `pin_threshold_label()` | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `seconds = int(raw) if raw.isdigit() and int(raw) > 0 else 86400` does not mirror `parse_pin_max_age_seconds` (`int(str(value).strip())`), so `"+3600"` falls back to 86400.
  WHY: The audit uses a 1-hour threshold but the report says "Behind stable for 24 hours or more". Fix: use try/int/except ValueError and fall back to 86400 when the value is <= 0.
- tests/test_update_workflows_template_gate.py:FAKE_CURL | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fake curl always exits 0, so the `curl -sS --fail ... || echo "::warning::Telegram send failed"` path in `verify_merge_blocked` has no test.
  WHY: A future regression (removing `--fail` or breaking `||`) would not be caught. Fix: make the fake exit `${FAKE_CURL_RC:-0}` and add a test with 22 that asserts the warning and exit 1.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: Issue #9483 fix 3: "Exempt update PRs that pass both `ai-update-workflows/verify` and `workflow-integrity` from `ai-review/head-gate`, or have the gate post success for them." The head gate "stayed `pending` the whole time".
  Expected change site: Something that re-runs `review_head_gate_updater_exempt`, or posts the head gate, after verify turns `success`, e.g. the verify job in .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml after `verify_publish` (the file is in files_touched).
  Evidence of absence: The exemption runs only in `review_head_gate_main`, the `review_enable_auto_merge.sh` updater exit, and the judge's `updater_verify_hold` branch. No hunk in update_workflows.yml posts or re-requests the head gate, and the gate stays pending if verify lands after the review tail exits. The "TASK_GAP_DEFERRED" note is not backed by the issue or plan. The window is narrow in practice.
- Note: The reviewer did not carry forward the pass-1 "pre-push test gate failures caused by this change" (z-ai), because those tests exercise files this PR does not touch and no failing check-run exists.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS repeat the three fixes above: the judge step env line, the pin_threshold_label parsing, and the FAKE_CURL_RC test (3 related items). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: `set -uo pipefail` will not catch the curl failure if the `echo` succeeds, which may mask Telegram delivery failures or make them hard to debug.

  PROBLEM: The judge step lacks `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_UPDATER_EXEMPT_ENABLED`, so it always defaults to `true`.
  WHY: The judge may post head-gate success on consumer-updater PRs even when the variable is set to `false`.
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:247-248 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `pin_threshold_label()` uses `raw.isdigit()`, which is stricter than `int()`.
  WHY: With `CONSUMER_PIN_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=+3600`, the label falls back to 86400 (24 hours) while the audit applies a 1-hour threshold.
- tests/test_update_workflows_template_gate.py:574 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `FAKE_CURL` always exits 0, so the `|| echo "::warning::Telegram send failed"` path is not exercised.
  WHY: Future changes could break the alert chain without CI catching it.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3

  Expected change site: Something that re-runs `review_head_gate_updater_exempt` after verify turns `success`: the verify job in .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml, or a trigger that re-runs review_autofix's head_gate step.
  Evidence of absence: The exemption is evaluated only in `review_head_gate_main`, `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` and `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2222`. The `verify_merge_blocked` step and the publish path never post or re-request the head gate, so a late verify leaves all three checks at `verify_missing`/`verify_not_success` and the gate `pending`.
